text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The on-going problems at Mhangura Copper Mine are mainly due to "very low grade" ore being produced at the mine, which under normal circumstances should have been closed down, deputy mines minister Zenzo Nsimbi said at the weekend.

- The Harare City Council will beef up its heavily depleted ambulance fleet during the next financial year beginning in July while allegations of indiscipline in the rescue department will be dealt with, mayor Solomon Tawengwa said at the weekend.
